description: This PHP file defines a migration class for version 4.3 of the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes database schema modifications, data insertion, and permission setup scripts as part of the system upgrade process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class extending AbstractMigration to perform database updates and permission configurations for version 4.3

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps, including inserting module info, permissions, configuration data, and creating a new database table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the migration, '4.3'.
